arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Estrada argued the Third Circuit wrongly treated damages as a merits issue.
Justice Ginsburg noted liability can be class-wide while damages remain individual.
Justice Breyer questioned why damages cannot be calculated using competitive benchmarks.
